name: ClassicHouse
title: Classic cottage house
description: Low-poly 1940s-style side-gabled cottage: white walls, dark shingle roof, arched gable porch on paired columns, red front door with sidelights, shuttered window pairs and brick chimney. Hollow, with a floor, ceiling, a front living room with a brick fireplace and two back rooms. Front and back doors are hinged and open inward. Furnished from 1940s interior references: living room with fireplace, bookcases, sofa, armchair, rug, dining set, sideboard and radio; kitchen with cabinets, sink, range, fridge and table; bedroom with bed, nightstands, dresser and wardrobe. The roof, ceiling and ceiling lights form RoofGroup, which can be hidden or lifted.

sources.note: refs/ref08.jpg: front view, side-gabled cottage with arched gable porch, paired columns, shuttered window pairs, chimney right of centre (CC BY-SA 2.0)
refs/ref14.jpg: same house type from a slightly different angle

reference.notes: Scale from the front door (2.1 m = 121 px, ~0.0175 m/px). Wall ~10.3 m wide, eave 3.4 m above ground, ridge ~5.9 m, foundation ~0.45 m, roof span 11.0 m, chimney top ~7.4 m. Porch gable ~5 m wide rising ~1.5 m, columns paired ~0.6 m apart, ~1.3 / 1.9 m off the door centre. Windows ~0.8 x 1.55 m in pairs with ~0.45 m shutters. Depth (8 m), roof pitch (~28 deg) and the floor plan are typical for the type, not measured. Made symmetric about the door.
